Monica — thanks for the forward and the summary. Short answers below and links attached.

1) Documentation: we need the manager justification (impact bullets), peer feedback (2+ notes), recent performance reviews, and a proposed comp band. For privacy-sensitive cases, a de-identified packet is fine for initial ELT discussion — final approval requires named docs.

2) Timeline: if ELT approves an exception, expect 7–14 business days for comp approvals in our typical process (faster if finance pre-clears). We can expedite to 3–5 business days with a completed comp request and finance sign-off.

3) Templates/links: compensation request form (https://hr.redwood.internal/forms/comp_request) and an expedited DocuSign flow (https://docusign.com/link/ABC-Redwood-Comp-Req). I attached a checklist and a sample manager justification template.
